name: CodeElevate
description: CodeElevate is a dynamic coder community platform empowering programmers, developers & students with coding & development stats, rankings, realtime messaging, connections, posts, notifications, profiles, search & filters, secure MFA/2FA with TOTP, QR & email OTP, intelligent caching, performance & SEO optimization, 3D animations, & responsive UI/UX

paragraphs: CodeElevate is a robust, scalable, and dynamic coder community platform built to empower competitive programmers, software developers, students, learners, and professionals.
